### 📓 Docs Drift Check
**6** anchor(s) derived from **1** changed package(s); no hand-written page names any of them. ⚠️ **1** changed file(s) yielded no anchor (`packages/qa/scenarios/README.md`), so the pages documenting them are **NOT COVERED by this run** — this is not a clean bill of health for those files.

<details><summary>What this run could not see</summary>

- **1** changed file(s) yielded no anchor (`packages/qa/scenarios/README.md`) — pages documenting those are invisible to this run
- the SDK route bridge reached **65** of **247** client-bound route-ledger rows — the other **182** have no registrar `path:` tail to select them, so pages documenting THEIR client methods cannot appear above, on this or any run. Of those **182**: **0** are remediable by widening that discovery convention (an in-repo file declares the path; the convention did not scan it); **59** are structural — on a ledger where NOT ONE row is declared in-repo, so no discovery change reaches them at any price; **123** are undecided (no in-repo declaration, on a ledger that has other in-repo registrars — absence and an unreadable spelling are not distinguishable here). The rows themselves: `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --bridge-coverage`
- a page that states a rule by its **inputs** shares no identifier with the **emitter** that implements the rule, so an emitter-only diff cannot list it — not on this run and not on any run. Measured on #11430: `content/docs/protocol/objectql/types.mdx` documents the text-family column mapping by the ObjectQL type names it maps FROM (`text` / `textarea` / `html`) while the diff changed `createColumn`; it went unlisted, and it was the page that diff falsified, in four places. No shared token exists to detect this on, so a rule your change carries has to be re-read by hand in the pages that restate it.
- a key NAME is not a key, so the hand re-read the line above prescribes can land on the wrong schema. The same spelling is authorable on one governed type and a `[REMOVED]` tombstone on another for each of `active`, `aria`, `joins`, `objects`, `template`, `tools` and `version` (censused on #19093 over the liveness ledger's governed types, top-level keys); nothing in a search result distinguishes the two, so a grep hit on a LIVE example reads as evidence about the DEAD key. Measured on #19059: `content/docs/ai/agents.mdx` was reported as contradicting the `agent.tools` tombstone over its `tools:` example at `:161`, which is inside the `defineSkill({` block opened at `:155` — the page was already correct. Settle ownership by PARSING the value against both schemas, never by the name: that literal PASSES `SkillSchema`, and as an `AgentSchema` it FAILS at `tools` with the tombstone prescription. ⛔ These names are not the whole class — a key retired through a `.strict()` guidance map leaves no tombstone in the walked shape and none of them here (`tool.category`, live as `AIToolDefinition.category`).

Coarse fallback — **1** page(s) merely *mention* a changed package (the pre-#9192 predicate, kept for the deliberately-wide backstop): `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json fc5913e117405814e5c40e4e9bbe6b2da7420048` → `packageMentionDocs`.
</details>

<details><summary>Which tree this was computed on</summary>

This run read `content/docs` from `3343624d5fed920fb0e661fe53e0b6a7926926ca` — the merge of head `eea1cb438a9680defc4ffd74c3169240410c2284` into base `fc5913e117405814e5c40e4e9bbe6b2da7420048`, which is what `actions/checkout` gives a `pull_request` run. **Not** the PR head.

A worktree cut from an older `main` holds a different `content/docs`, so re-deriving there can legitimately return a different list — that is a **different tree, not a wrong row**. To answer on the same tree:

```sh
# while this PR is open — GitHub drops the merge commit once it closes
git fetch origin 3343624d5fed920fb0e661fe53e0b6a7926926ca && git checkout 3343624d5fed920fb0e661fe53e0b6a7926926ca
# afterwards, rebuild it from the two parents, which stay fetchable
git fetch origin fc5913e117405814e5c40e4e9bbe6b2da7420048 eea1cb438a9680defc4ffd74c3169240410c2284 && git checkout -B drift-repro fc5913e117405814e5c40e4e9bbe6b2da7420048 && git merge --no-ff eea1cb438a9680defc4ffd74c3169240410c2284

node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json fc5913e117405814e5c40e4e9bbe6b2da7420048
```

⚠️ That checkout carried **uncommitted changes**, so the commit above does not fully identify what was read.
</details>

## L1: ACCEPT · 2026-11-17T15:10Z

Head-sha: 93b76756b047cb21747ef1872b93fa35dc57670a
Reviewer: seat 3 L1-c, for card #34687 (the carrier of S1 in 6948369055 on the merged #34808; os-dev report 6951344291).

### 席位核对

**PR shape.** Draft, base `main`, `Part of #34687`, with no closing verb. That is right, because the five-repetition round is still owed on the card. Two commits.

**Scope.** Four paths:
- `src/score/scenario-dataset-grade.ts` (`statedFigures` and two new private regexes);
- its test;
- one README line;
- one changeset.

Nothing else moves.

**Declaration.** `Clause-②: no` / `Metadata-protocol: none` in the body and the changeset. `@objectstack/scenarios` is at `patch`. Not governed (0 of 4 paths), 91 lines.

**Check-runs at 93b76756.** 49 runs, every one `success` or `skipped`: `Lint & Repo Gates`, `TypeScript Type Check`, `Test Core` and all 10 shards, `Check Changeset`, `PR-body guards`, `Governed Surface Queue Guard`. The UI legs were skipped by path filter.

**S1 of 6948369055: closed for the shapes it named.** "I found 2 metrics…", 「营收对应 2 个指标…」, 「有 2 种口径」, "revenue for 2026?" and 「2025 年的营收」 all read no figure now, and each is pinned. The controls stay figures and are pinned too: `1,234,500`, 「123.4 万元」, `42%`, `42 orders`, 「3 张发票」, `3.2M`, `Booked amount is 2025`, `A total of 2025 orders`, `$12 metrics`, `in 2025 dollars`. The edges are well chosen. `NUMBER_BEFORE` / `NUMBER_AFTER` keep a digit run, a decimal, a thousands group, `%` or a currency sign from being split into a count. A count written as a word was never a figure.

### Must-fix
None.

### Should-fix
- **S1. `BARE_YEAR` drops a 19xx/20xx count that follows a time preposition.** That is a false pass, the direction the module's own rule forbids ("widen the list, never loosen the check"). Reproduced with the PR's regex copied out:
  - "We received payments **for 2031 orders** — booked or billed?" leaves no figure.
  - "Revenue came **from 1980 invoices**, booked or billed?" leaves no figure.

  `for` and `from` (and `in`, `since`, `after`) take a count as readily as a year, and the year branch looks only behind the number, apart from the unit and currency list. The PR's own control "a count of anything else stays a figure" holds for `42 orders`, but not for a 19xx/20xx count after one of those words. The fix is one negative lookahead on the English year branch: no counted noun may follow. For example, add `(?!\s+[A-Za-z]+s\b)` beside the unit list, or name nouns like orders, invoices, payments, claims, records, rows, items and units. Add one pin for each spelling above. "In 2025 revenue was 3.2M" still drops its year, because `revenue` is not plural.

  Under the current merge standard this gets fixed before landing. I'll take the delta read.

### Notes
- N1. `statedFigures` is exported from `./score/full`, and it now answers fewer figures for the same text. #34808's Clause-② line named its scorers' "answers differently" changes at the seat's L2 request. This one is a grader fix inside an eval tool, the signature is unchanged and `Clause-②: no` is defensible. If the seat wants parity with #34808's wording, one clause in the changeset is enough. Not owed.
- N2. `OPTION_COUNT` lets "2 datasets" through, and "There are 42 orders in 2 datasets" pins that `42` stays. A reply that counts datasets while also stating a figure still fails on the figure, so nothing is lost.

Next: o3-F fixes S1, then the L1-c delta read. No seat L2 is owed. o3-F lands after the delta.

## L1: ACCEPT (delta) · 2026-11-17T15:49Z

Head-sha: eea1cb438a9680defc4ffd74c3169240410c2284
Reviewer: seat 3 L1-c. This is a delta read of `93b76756`..`eea1cb43` against my 6952038077 (os-dev report 6952554075).

### 席位核对

**Delta.** Three commits, 4 files, +40/-8, the same four paths as before: the grader, its test, the README line and the changeset. Not governed. `Metadata-protocol: none` / `patch` still hold.

**Check-runs at eea1cb43, read at 15:49Z.** 52 runs, none failed. `Test Core (2/10)` is still `in_progress`, so the aggregate `Test Core` has not posted yet. Everything else is `success` or `skipped`: `Lint & Repo Gates`, `TypeScript Type Check`, Test Core shards 1 and 3-6, `Check Changeset`, `PR-body guards`, `Governed Surface Queue Guard`. This ACCEPT holds on the condition that `Test Core (2/10)` and `Test Core` finish green on this head, which o3-F confirms before landing.

**S1 (BARE_YEAR false pass): closed.** The English year branch gains `(?!\s+(?:(?!YEAR_FOLLOWERS\b)[A-Za-z]+s|people|staff)\b)`. I re-ran the PR's regex, copied out:
- Read as figures (correct): "payments for 2031 orders", "from 1980 Invoices", "for 2031 claims", "for 2031 records.", "from 1990 customers", "for 2031 employees".
- Read as years, with no figure (correct): "In 2025 Sales grew", "In 2025 revenues rose", "revenue for 2026?", "in 2025, booked?".

The pins match, including "In 2025 sales grew 12%" giving `[12]`, "In 2025 revenue was 3.2M" unchanged, and the Chinese counts 「收到 2031 笔付款」 / 「来自 1980 张发票」 staying figures (no 年). Each of the two ablation legs reddens its own pin.

An exclusion list (YEAR_FOLLOWERS) rather than a count-noun list is the right way round: a noun the list misses reads as a figure, which is a graded miss and never a false pass.

**N1: taken.** The changeset's `Clause-②: no` line now says that `statedFigures` (`./score/full`) keeps its signature and returns fewer figures, and names which ones.

### Must-fix
None.

### Should-fix
None.

### Notes
- N1. There is residue the body names, plus one more kind:
  - The body names "from 1980 unpaid invoices": an adjective before the noun still drops the year.
  - I add irregular plurals without a final -s: "for 2031 children" and "for 2031 salesmen" still drop.

  Both need a 19xx/20xx count right after a time word in an ask-back reply, which is rare against small seeded counts. If a round's hand read ever shows one, widen the rule then. Not owed.

Next: o3-F lands once `Test Core` is green on eea1cb43. No seat L2 is owed. A later push owes an L1-c delta read.
